subject: Political Science
central_question: Why have environmental degradation and competition over natural resources become central political issues requiring unequal but shared responsibilities?

known_pitfalls.claim: Environmental issues are only scientific and therefore outside politics.
known_pitfalls.correction: They are political because governments allocate resources, distribute costs, regulate behaviour and negotiate international responsibility.

known_pitfalls.claim: Common but differentiated responsibilities means developing countries have no environmental obligations.
known_pitfalls.correction: All states share responsibility, but developed states are expected to bear a larger burden because of their historical contribution and greater capabilities.
